title: Experts Exhibit Structured Redundancy: Structure-Preserving Expert Pruning for Mixture-of-Experts Large Language Models
summary: Primary v1 §§4 and 7 report an empirical model-internal property: stable and entropy effective ranks remain far below nominal expert counts (reaching about 63–65%) and expert-output distributions have fewer effective modes across two MoE models. The resulting structured redundancy is a concrete CS finding, with pruning experiments as follow-up validation.
ai_technology: Learned MoE expert outputs and router statistics are analyzed to infer functional and distributional structure
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material
